translations.web: If you don’t know, most beautiful among women, follow the tracks of the sheep. Graze your young goats beside the shepherds’ tents.
translations.bsb: If you do not know, O fairest of women, follow the tracks of the flock, and graze your young goats near the tents of the shepherds.
translations.kjv: If thou know not, O thou fairest among women, go thy way forth by the footsteps of the flock, and feed thy kids beside the shepherds' tents.
translations.asv: If thou know not, O thou fairest among women, Go thy way forth by the footsteps of the flock, And feed thy kids beside the shepherds' tents.
